subject: physics

hotspots.label: Wire
hotspots.description: The transparent conductor crowded with the streaming electron dots.
hotspots.colorHint: Gleaming clear tube with pale gold dots inside.
hotspots.function: Carries the current from battery to bulb.

hotspots.label: Battery
hotspots.description: The power cell that pushes the electron stream onto the loop.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm cell with a red cap and − marked ring.
hotspots.function: Supplies the push that keeps the electrons moving.

hotspots.label: Bulb
hotspots.description: The small lamp that turns current into light — brighter as the flow climbs.
hotspots.colorHint: Clear tiny bulb with a warm glow inside.
hotspots.function: Converts current into light and heat.

hotspots.label: Ammeter
hotspots.description: The instrument reading the flow in amperes at the loop.
hotspots.colorHint: Pale-green round gauge on a small stand.

hotspots.label: Flow Slider
hotspots.description: Tunes the march of the dots; the ammeter and bulb follow.
hotspots.colorHint: Horizontal slider on a small pedestal.
hotspots.function: Sets the flow the model demonstrates.

hotspots.label: Break Switch
hotspots.description: Cuts a gap out of the wire and freezes the whole stream instantly.
hotspots.colorHint: A small lever switch toggling a removable segment.
hotspots.function: Demonstrates that a break stops the whole loop.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A transparent cool-blue loop of glass tube, gold streaming dots, warm battery and a green round ammeter.
materialNotes: Glass tube: roughness ~0.15, metallic 0 (clear). Dots: small rounded gold spheres, no emissive bloom but slightly self-lit. Metal caps of battery pale ochre.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: current seen as streaming charge on a loop with an ammeter.

GEOMETRY: loop made of a transparent tube (wire) with pill-of-dots inside; battery left, bulb right, ammeter stand; slider pedestal and a removable break segment on the loop.

INTERACTION: the slider raises dot speed and ammeter value; the break lever lifts a segment and halts every dot; bulb dims as slider lowers.

NAMED EDGES: WireLoop, ElectronStream, Battery, Bulb, Ammeter, FlowSlider, BreakSegment. ~7-10k tris.
